column1: # Dated structural events for the WW2 v1 variables (docs/ontology_ww2_v1.md)
# Same format and conventions as events_ww2.csv: one row per event and variable
# rows whose level equals the level in force are dated confirming observations; a '?' in the source cell marks a
# date or reference recalled but not verified (the note says which). Rows before 1936 defend the 1936Q1 initial levels.

column6: source
